answer: Each active identity forfeits a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through an ivory debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the garden totals, and the anchor anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 2 units per epoch, sustaining 371 aliases for 11 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the copycat. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
